answer: Treat each new agent as an island that must be bridged before it earns: it posts a 50-token bond, and the bond doubles for every extra account tied to the same funding wallet, so a fifth linked fake locks 800. It also needs two established vouchers staking 10 each, and a voucher may back only three newcomers per epoch, so a swarm quickly runs out of sponsors. A nebula of fakes can't hide either: one whisper of shared timing or payouts triggers clustering, and the whole cluster's bonds are slashed together.
